verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships an official `local-ai` binary CLI with subcommands for gallery model management (`local-ai models list`), running models from huggingface:// or ollama:// URIs (`local-ai run`), and an agentic `local-ai chat` that reads files and runs shell commands behind an approval gate. Its documented CLI flags include `--external-grpc-backends` and `--preload-models`. Missing for 10: a comprehensive CLI command reference, documentation of machine-readable/scriptable output modes, and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: local-ai models list          # List available models in the gallery
an agent in your own shell. local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
`local-ai chat`, an agent in your shell that runs commands behind an approval gate.
The --external-grpc-backends parameter in the CLI can be used either to specify a local backend (a file) or a remote URL.
